title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: Anthropic API
providers.scope_notes: Covers Anthropic Claude API (Claude Console / Claude Platform). Claude Console organizations on platform.claude.com; Claude Enterprise (claude.ai) compliance keys and App Attest device tokens are noted but not catalogued as paths.

controls.name: Maximum expiration policy
controls.what: Console limits key expiration to the policy maximum and removes Never.

controls.name: Compliance API (Activity Feed)
controls.what: Must be on for key and federation activity to be recorded.
controls.setting: Claude Console > Settings > Security > Compliance API
controls.plan: Eligible organizations (self-service) or via account team

controls_unknown: Customer IP allowlisting for Claude API requests (not found in docs).
Whether keys or OAuth tokens are subject to SSO / IdP conditional access.
Whether disabling a key or archiving a rule ends already-minted WIF tokens immediately.
Lifetime and admin revocation of ant CLI OAuth tokens.
Console UI path for the maximum expiration policy and the member API key creation setting.
Whether Messages API calls generate Activity Feed events (feed excludes prompt/response text).

authentication.summary: sk-ant-admin... key sent in x-api-key for the Admin, Usage and Cost, Rate Limits APIs and the Compliance Activity Feed.

federation.details: Fetched docs do not say whether API keys are subject to SSO or IdP conditional access.

ip_restriction.boundary: No customer IP allowlist for Claude API requests found in fetched docs; the IP addresses page only lists Anthropic's own ranges.

lifetime.summary: Same expiration choice as API keys at creation

administration.summary: Only members with the admin role can provision one, in Console > Settings > Admin keys. Use is logged as admin_api_key_actor.
administration.conditions: Claude Enterprise (claude.ai) uses separate scoped keys; out of scope here.

inventory.details: Admin API keys are listed on the Admin keys page (platform.claude.com/settings/admin-keys) in the Claude Console. No API list endpoint for admin keys was found.

expiry.ui: Console > Admin keys (platform.claude.com/settings/admin-keys) > Create admin key > choose key expiration

log_sources.name: Compliance API Activity Feed (GET /v1/compliance/activities)
log_sources.notes: Must be enabled; 6-year retention; not retroactive. Admin API keys can read it.

log_sources.name: Usage and Cost API
log_sources.notes: Aggregated usage filterable by API key.

containment.steps: Deactivate or delete the admin key in Console > Settings > Admin keys.
containment.notes: Deleting an Admin API key takes effect on the next request, with no grace period.

calls.log_notes: Activity Feed has an org_users_listed event with an admin_api_key_actor type (admin_api_key_id); docs do not explicitly tie the event to this endpoint. Recording starts only once the Compliance API is enabled.

unknown: Whether Admin API reads are logged

detections.title: Anthropic Admin API Key Created
detections.detects: An Anthropic Admin API key was created.

detections.title: Anthropic Admin API Key Deleted
detections.detects: An Anthropic Admin API key was deleted.
